10.english_meaning: Pictures, drawings, or diagrams in a book used to explain or decorate text
10.example: The illustrations in the storybook helped the young children understand the story easily.

10.english_meaning: To represent or show something through a drawing, painting, or words
10.example: The painting depicts a peaceful village scene at sunset.

10.english_meaning: The situation or background circumstances in which something happens or is written
10.example: You must understand the historical context of the poem to fully appreciate its meaning.

10.english_meaning: To improve the quality, amount, or strength of something
10.example: Adding colorful charts can enhance the clarity of your presentation.

10.english_meaning: The ability to understand something completely
10.example: Reading regularly improves your reading comprehension and vocabulary.

10.english_meaning: Gave support, confidence, or hope to someone to do something
10.example: The teacher encouraged the students to ask questions whenever they had doubts.

10.english_meaning: To think deeply or carefully about something
10.example: After reading the moral story, students were asked to reflect on their own behavior.

10.english_meaning: In a genuine, honest, and heartfelt manner
10.example: She apologized sincerely for arriving late to the class.

10.english_meaning: The abilities, skills, or knowledge required to do something successfully
10.example: The new curriculum focuses on developing practical language competencies in students.

10.english_meaning: Relating to education, schools, colleges, or study
10.example: The school awards prizes every year to students with outstanding academic achievements.
